Nothing reloads by itself, and an agent on a call is asked to reload after the call.

One set of supported browsers, checked on every change: Chrome and Edge 111 or later, Firefox 128 or later and Safari 16.4 or later (Mac, iPhone and iPad). An older browser is told so on the sign-in page instead of showing a blank screen.

Two-step sign-in: platform operators must now use an authenticator app, and are asked to set one up at their next sign-in. Each tenant chooses under Security whether nobody, its administrators and supervisors, or everyone must use one. People who sign in with Google or Microsoft use that provider's own. Administrators can reset a person's authenticator under Users.

Problem reports and suggestions from the ? button go to the platform's operators only, by email: every operator, one group address, or nobody (Platform → Snags).

Users → Add several people: paste a team from a spreadsheet (name, email, role) and each is added and invited; anyone already there is listed, not added twice.

On staging, Load demo setup (Platform → Tenants) fills a tenant with a working contact centre to try everything on.

A stricter browser security policy is reported on first, before it is enforced. A server pair's second server now follows each release's call server too."}
